data.label: Tenant administrator
data.description: Manage the filtering rules, privacy settings and deletion requests for one tenant.

buildSpec.inputs: An authenticated administrator and a selected tenant.
buildSpec.outputs: An auditable request for a policy revision or history deletion.
buildSpec.behavior: Manage the filtering rules, privacy settings and deletion requests for one tenant.
buildSpec.implementation: Show a rule diff and require confirmation of a change to retention.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Existing identity provider and administrator browser.
buildSpec.operations: Review operator membership quarterly and revoke departed administrators.
buildSpec.failures: End revoked sessions and verify another tenant cannot read the profile.
buildSpec.tests: Use two synthetic tenants to verify the boundary.

data.label: Configuration API
data.description: Authorize profile changes and keep their revision history.

buildSpec.inputs: An authenticated change with tenant, profile, expected version and request ID.
buildSpec.outputs: A committed revision or a conflict response.
buildSpec.behavior: Authorize profile changes and keep their revision history.
buildSpec.implementation: Check tenant membership on every request. Use optimistic concurrency and idempotency keys.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Replicated control-plane database with encrypted backups and a restore rehearsal.
buildSpec.operations: Audit administrative actions using tenant, action and revision. Exclude DNS questions.
buildSpec.failures: Reject stale writes. Recover an acknowledged revision from backup before reopening edits.
buildSpec.tests: Verify cross-tenant denial and retrying an accepted write.

verificationCases.name: Reject a cross-tenant profile change
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Tenant A and B each own a profile and a test administrator.
verificationCases.input: Administrator A submits an edit to profile B.
verificationCases.action: Attempt the change and read back both profile revisions.
verificationCases.expected: The edit is denied. Both revisions retain their original contents.
verificationCases.evidence: Response status and before-and-after revision digests.

data.label: Policy publisher
data.description: Compile and distribute an immutable policy snapshot to the resolver fleet.

buildSpec.inputs: A committed profile revision with allow rules, deny rules and logging consent.
buildSpec.outputs: A signed snapshot, version digest and per-region activation acknowledgment.
buildSpec.behavior: Compile and distribute an immutable policy snapshot to the resolver fleet.
buildSpec.implementation: Compile deterministically, sign the manifest and activate it atomically. Keep the last working version.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Pinned signing identity and regional read-only distribution replicas.
buildSpec.operations: Compare desired and active versions. Pause a rollout when activation diverges.
buildSpec.failures: Reject an incomplete or unsigned snapshot. Restore the previous digest without changing the source history.
buildSpec.tests: Simulate interrupted distribution and replay the same version.

verificationCases.name: Retain the last working policy
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Both regions serve revision A and a canary distinguishes revisions A and B.
verificationCases.input: An interrupted transfer of revision B.
verificationCases.action: Stop publication halfway and query the canary in each region.
verificationCases.expected: Each lookup uses one complete revision. The incomplete revision never becomes active.
verificationCases.evidence: Region-specific active digest and query result.

steps.action: Submit a reviewed policy diff against the current version.
Commit and compile the tenant-scoped version.
Verify signature and canaries before atomic activation.
Compare digests and roll back a divergent region.

data.label: Client devices
data.description: Send DNS questions over an encrypted transport using the selected profile.

buildSpec.inputs: A configured endpoint and a controlled fixture name.
buildSpec.outputs: A DNS answer, policy block or bounded failure.
buildSpec.behavior: Send DNS questions over an encrypted transport using the selected profile.
buildSpec.implementation: Qualify a native DoH client and a router proxy. Treat the profile identifier as routing data.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Customer device or branch router. Keep the previous resolver configuration available.
buildSpec.operations: Record the effective resolver and transport on a designated canary device.
buildSpec.failures: Restore the saved device profile if the rollout fails.
buildSpec.tests: Repeat the allow and deny fixtures on both client paths.

data.label: Resolver ingress
data.description: Terminate encrypted DNS, select the profile and enforce bounded request budgets.

buildSpec.inputs: A DNS wire message over DoH or DoT.
buildSpec.outputs: A DNS wire response returned to the originating client.
buildSpec.behavior: Terminate encrypted DNS, select the profile and enforce bounded request budgets.
buildSpec.implementation: Validate message size, apply admission limits and pass a typed request context to the evaluator.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Two independently drainable regions with health-checked ingress and expiring certificates.
buildSpec.operations: Check certificate expiry, saturation, transport errors and synthetic resolution from both regions.
buildSpec.failures: Drain an unhealthy region and keep the surviving region within its capacity budget.
buildSpec.tests: Run DoH and DoT canaries and a controlled regional drain.

verificationCases.name: Run both encrypted transports
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: One native DoH client and one DoT test client point to the same synthetic profile.
verificationCases.input: An allowed fixture name with a known A record.
verificationCases.action: Query both endpoints and compare decoded DNS messages.
verificationCases.expected: Both return the expected record under the selected profile.
verificationCases.evidence: Redacted wire transcripts with time and transport.

verificationCases.name: Drain one resolver region
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Two test regions have identical policies. The surviving region has reserved headroom.
verificationCases.input: Synthetic allowed and denied queries during a regional drain.
verificationCases.action: Withdraw one region and measure successful answers from external probes.
verificationCases.expected: Both policy outcomes recover within the proposed 60-second target.
verificationCases.evidence: Probe timeline, active regions and capacity during the drain.

steps.action: Report rising failures by region and protocol.
Check secondary headroom and drain the affected region.
Verify allow and deny outcomes before restoring traffic.

data.label: Policy evaluator
data.description: Evaluate the active tenant policy before releasing an answer or starting recursion.

buildSpec.inputs: A normalized question and an immutable tenant, profile and policy version.
buildSpec.outputs: A local deny result or an allowed lookup tagged with its policy version.
buildSpec.behavior: Evaluate the active tenant policy before releasing an answer or starting recursion.
buildSpec.implementation: Pin one snapshot per query. Evaluate explicit custom rules before default lists. Define ties in the policy contract.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Region-local policy snapshots. A cached raw upstream answer still passes through the requesting profile policy.
buildSpec.operations: Sample decision latency and active versions using aggregate counters.
buildSpec.failures: Serve the last valid snapshot during a control-plane outage. Return a bounded error for an unknown profile.
buildSpec.tests: Prime the cache with tenant A, then deny the same name for tenant B.

verificationCases.name: Isolate policy after a shared cache hit
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Tenant A allows a controlled name and tenant B denies it.
verificationCases.input: Two requests for the same name with different profiles.
verificationCases.action: Prime raw DNS data through A, then query through B.
verificationCases.expected: A receives the fixture record. B receives its configured block response.
verificationCases.evidence: Both DNS responses, active policy versions and the upstream counter.

data.label: Recursive resolver
data.description: Resolve permitted questions and cache upstream DNS data within its TTL.

buildSpec.inputs: An allowed DNS question, deadline and DNSSEC validation context.
buildSpec.outputs: Validated DNS data or the corresponding resolution error.
buildSpec.behavior: Resolve permitted questions and cache upstream DNS data within its TTL.
buildSpec.implementation: Use a maintained validating resolver. Cache raw DNS data independently of tenant-specific policy decisions.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Regional cache and egress to authoritative DNS. Keep capacity for cold-cache recovery.
buildSpec.operations: Track cache hit rate, resolution errors and upstream latency by region.
buildSpec.failures: Return an appropriate error on bogus validation or expired query deadlines.
buildSpec.tests: Compare a signed good fixture with a deliberately invalid signed test fixture.

verificationCases.name: Keep a blocked name off the upstream path
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: An empty recursive cache and a controlled upstream counter start at zero.
verificationCases.input: A fresh name on the deny list.
verificationCases.action: Send the request and read the counter.
verificationCases.expected: The response indicates the configured block and the upstream counter stays zero.
verificationCases.evidence: Counter snapshots and the blocked result.

verificationCases.name: Measure throughput and tail latency
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Use a controlled zone and a fixed mix of fresh and repeated names.
verificationCases.input: A proposed 500 queries per second with an 80 percent warm-cache mix.
verificationCases.action: Run the load window and record latency histograms per cache state.
verificationCases.expected: Both distributions and error rates are reported. Expansion requires owner review of the budget.
verificationCases.evidence: Load parameters, p50, p95, error rate and CPU utilization.

data.label: Authoritative DNS
data.description: Provide upstream DNS records for permitted names.

buildSpec.inputs: A recursive lookup for the team-owned fixture zone.
buildSpec.outputs: Authoritative DNS data and DNSSEC material where configured.
buildSpec.behavior: Provide upstream DNS records for permitted names.
buildSpec.implementation: Reference the public DNS ecosystem. Operate a separate controlled test zone for repeatable qualification.
buildSpec.infrastructure: External authoritative servers and team-owned test zone.
buildSpec.operations: Record fixture revisions and TTLs when comparing observations.
buildSpec.failures: Distinguish authoritative timeout from policy denial in aggregate outcomes.
buildSpec.tests: Use fresh and cached fixture names to observe both query paths.

data.label: Privacy gate
data.description: Discard query events unless the profile permits storage in the approved region.

buildSpec.inputs: A query event, consent version and nominated storage region.
buildSpec.outputs: A minimal regional event or immediate discard.
buildSpec.behavior: Discard query events unless the profile permits storage in the approved region.
buildSpec.implementation: Discard on missing, revoked or inconsistent consent. Recheck queued events before writing.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Bounded regional queue. Backpressure must never hold a DNS response open.
buildSpec.operations: Alert on discarded backlog and regional routing mismatches using aggregate counts.
buildSpec.failures: Drop optional events when the gate or log store is unavailable.
buildSpec.tests: Revoke consent with an event queued and verify it cannot reach storage.

verificationCases.name: Discard an event after revocation
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: A diagnostic event is queued in a synthetic opted-in profile.
verificationCases.input: A revocation committed before the queued write.
verificationCases.action: Resume the consumer and inspect both candidate stores.
verificationCases.expected: No query row is written after the revocation. Resolution still completes.
verificationCases.evidence: Consent versions, synthetic query response and empty result set.

data.label: Regional query history
data.description: Store explicitly opted-in records under the tenant’s region and retention settings.

buildSpec.inputs: A permitted event or an authorized deletion request.
buildSpec.outputs: Tenant-scoped query history or a deletion receipt.
buildSpec.behavior: Store explicitly opted-in records under the tenant’s region and retention settings.
buildSpec.implementation: Partition by tenant and time. Apply expiration and idempotent deletion over the selected profile.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Separate regional storage and restricted operator access. Decide backup deletion policy before launch.
buildSpec.operations: Verify retention expiry with a synthetic tenant and periodically rehearse deletion.
buildSpec.failures: On storage failure shed optional telemetry. Track incomplete erasure as owned operational work.
buildSpec.tests: Verify expiry, cross-tenant isolation and a deletion retry.

verificationCases.name: Resume tenant-scoped erasure
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Create expired and current fixtures for two tenants in the chosen region.
verificationCases.input: A deletion operation interrupted after its first batch.
verificationCases.action: Resume twice and inspect the requested range and the other tenant.
verificationCases.expected: The selected rows are gone. The other tenant retains its rows. The receipt completes once.
verificationCases.evidence: Region, deletion receipt, before-and-after row counts.

data.label: Fleet telemetry
data.description: Measure service health without retaining individual questions or client addresses.

buildSpec.inputs: Region, protocol, outcome class, duration bucket and count.
buildSpec.outputs: Bounded aggregate metrics, alerts and an availability dashboard.
buildSpec.behavior: Measure service health without retaining individual questions or client addresses.
buildSpec.implementation: Allowlist metric labels. Never attach query names, profile IDs or client network addresses.
buildSpec.infrastructure: Independent monitoring sink with fixed label cardinality.
buildSpec.operations: Page the on-call resolver operator on sustained error rate or regional saturation.
buildSpec.failures: Use an independent canary when the metrics pipeline is down.
buildSpec.tests: Inspect exported metric labels during a controlled outage.

verificationCases.name: Inspect telemetry field boundaries
verificationCases.environment: Isolated two-tenant service fixture with team-controlled DNS records.
verificationCases.setup: Capture a metrics export for an isolated workload.
verificationCases.input: A unique synthetic query name and a unique profile selector.
verificationCases.action: Generate success and failure queries and inspect all metric labels.
verificationCases.expected: Only the documented bounded dimensions appear. Neither unique value occurs.
verificationCases.evidence: Schema inspection and redacted sample of emitted metrics.

interfaceSpec.transport: HTTPS JSON with a revision precondition
interfaceSpec.input: Tenant, profile, expected revision, rule diff and idempotency key.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Resolve tenant membership server-side on every request.
interfaceSpec.failure: Retry with the same key. On conflict show the current revision.
interfaceSpec.verification: Replay a write and attempt a write from another tenant.

interfaceSpec.input: Tenant-scoped revision, consent settings and content digest.
interfaceSpec.output: Compilation receipt bound to the source revision.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Publisher reads committed revisions with a dedicated identity.
interfaceSpec.failure: Replay by revision and refuse a mismatched digest.
interfaceSpec.verification: Deliver the same change twice and compare compiled digests.

interfaceSpec.input: Manifest, signature and immutable rule payload.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Verify the signing key before activation.
interfaceSpec.failure: Keep the previous snapshot on integrity failure or interruption.
interfaceSpec.verification: Interrupt a regional update and confirm atomic activation.

interfaceSpec.transport: DNS over HTTPS or DNS over TLS
interfaceSpec.input: DNS query and selected resolver endpoint.
interfaceSpec.output: DNS wire response or documented transport error.
interfaceSpec.authorization: TLS authenticates the service. The profile selector grants no management access.
interfaceSpec.failure: Honor the query deadline and retain the client’s documented rollback path.
interfaceSpec.verification: Compare allowed and denied fixtures over both transports.

interfaceSpec.input: Question, profile, deadline and correlation context without durable tracking.
interfaceSpec.output: Allow or block result under one active version.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Only the ingress workload can call the evaluator.
interfaceSpec.failure: Unknown profiles fail with a bounded error. Never borrow another tenant’s rules.
interfaceSpec.verification: Use contradictory policies for the same name across two tenants.

interfaceSpec.input: Allowed question with remaining budget and validation flags.
interfaceSpec.output: Validated DNS data or a resolver failure.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Only the evaluator can request recursion.
interfaceSpec.failure: Expire requests at the deadline. A block must generate zero upstream lookups.
interfaceSpec.verification: Count upstream calls for allowed and denied names.

interfaceSpec.input: A cache miss for a permitted fixture name.
interfaceSpec.output: Resource records, TTL or authoritative failure.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Validate DNSSEC where the trust chain applies.
interfaceSpec.failure: Bound retries and preserve the distinction between failure and denial.
interfaceSpec.verification: Test a valid response, a timeout and bogus signed data.

interfaceSpec.input: Minimal decision event and consent context.
interfaceSpec.output: Accepted for privacy checks or discarded.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Evaluator can submit events only to its regional gate.
interfaceSpec.failure: Shed optional events on saturation while continuing resolution.
interfaceSpec.verification: Make history unavailable during an allowed lookup.

interfaceSpec.input: Tenant-scoped event, retention deadline and consent version.
interfaceSpec.output: Stored event identifier or a discard result.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Verify current opt-in and approved region before writing.
interfaceSpec.failure: Discard after consent revocation. Never send overflow to another region.
interfaceSpec.verification: Revoke a queued event and inspect both regional stores.

interfaceSpec.transport: Batched metrics with a fixed dimension set
interfaceSpec.input: Region, protocol, outcome and duration bucket.
interfaceSpec.output: A monotonic aggregate or a dropped batch counter.
interfaceSpec.failure: DNS continues if metrics are unavailable.
interfaceSpec.verification: Assert absence of query names, addresses and profile identifiers.

interfaceSpec.input: Tenant, profile, time range and idempotency key.
interfaceSpec.output: A durable receipt with completion state.
interfaceSpec.authorization: Require a tenant administrator and restrict the worker to that tenant and region.
interfaceSpec.failure: Resume partial deletion using the same operation ID.
interfaceSpec.verification: Delete a fixture range twice and retain rows belonging to another tenant.

assumptions.statement: Illustrative baseline of 500 queries per second for 30 days, giving 1.296 billion queries per month.
An 80% cache hit assumption gives approximately 259.2 million upstream lookups per month before retries.
With 1% opt-in and 200 bytes per event, raw log ingestion is approximately 2.592 GB per month before indexes and replication.
Destination, transit, compute, storage, support and engineering rates require quotations.

systemSpec.title: Protective DNS service
systemSpec.decomposition: Start with a controlled zone, two contradictory tenant profiles and one regional resolver. Prove allow, block and cache isolation before connecting the policy publisher. Add opt-in history after tests cover revocation and deletion. Rehearse a regional drain before broadening traffic.
systemSpec.infrastructure: Separate configuration and signing workloads from regional query handling. Serve immutable policy revisions locally. Keep each opted-in query history in its selected jurisdiction. Select the hosting provider and regional pair after capacity and residency review.
systemSpec.operations: Roll out a single signed revision to a canary region, verify synthetic allow and deny responses, then advance or restore the last accepted digest. On sustained resolver errors, check secondary capacity, drain traffic, verify both transports and reintroduce traffic in stages. Continue DNS during a history outage.
systemSpec.testing: Use two synthetic tenants, conflicting policies and a controlled authoritative zone. Trace outbound lookups, inspect both regional stores, and record the active policy revision. Run warm and cold load separately. Collect latency, failure rate and recovery measurements before approving a production target.
